selector.rationale: Patient presents with fever, flank pain, and foul-smelling urine, with laboratory studies showing leukocytosis, hyponatremia, and urinalysis positive for leukocyte esterase, nitrites, and white blood cells, and blood and urine cultures growing Escherichia coli

rejected.label: Nephrolithiasis
rejected.why: Non-obstructing nephrolithiasis is present but does not explain the patient's symptoms and laboratory findings

rejected.label: Cytomegalovirus Infection
rejected.why: Although the patient has detectable CMV viremia, the current symptoms and laboratory findings are more consistent with a bacterial urinary tract infection

rejected.label: Bladder Cancer
rejected.why: While the CT scan shows irregular, nodular thickening of the bladder wall suspicious for neoplasm, the patient's acute symptoms and laboratory findings are more consistent with a urinary tract infection
